description: After Codex restart, the successor cstar-kernel is not exposed and no successor-root process is running; determine whether the wrapper, package/bin linkage, dependencies, runtime, or app-server startup path is responsible without mutating CStar/Hall.

statement: The successor startup fails before MCP registration because the wrapper pins a possibly absent Node v25.8.1 and the successor worktree has no node_modules; if the successor and existing truth dependency locks match exactly, a bounded wrapper/linkage repair may be safe, otherwise stop.

observations: The no-dependency startup hypothesis is confirmed for the successor: its tsx loader path is absent because node_modules is absent, while the pinned Node v25.8.1 exists and satisfies the package engine. The Node pin is not itself the failure.

statement: If the truth-root node_modules tree has the same package-lock package entries and exact required package versions as the successor lock, then a successor-local symlink to that existing tree will provide the accepted source with a lock-compatible dependency root without installation or source copying.

observations: The symlink repair starts the successor MCP and passes initialize/tools/list, but supported cstar_doctor/status report dependency_lineage=partial and Forge readiness false with forge_runtime_dependency_lineage_partial, forge_runtime_required_native_artifacts_partial, and forge_runtime_private_runtime_partial. The external real dependency root is not accepted as canonical successor lineage.

statement: If the runtime lineage contract supports an explicit verified dependency root or launcher-derived dependency path, then a wrapper-only adjustment can preserve successor code_root while making dependency_lineage valid without installing, copying source, changing package locks, or mutating Hall.

No wrapper-only or symlink linkage can satisfy the accepted successor runtime contract: the contract requires a real successor-local node_modules tree and a valid successor Forge runtime manifest; the current worktree has neither, and the existing manifest is the retired Hermes/MiniMax contract.

observations: The only bounded linkage test was reverted because the accepted runtime contract rejects the symlink. The remaining gate requires successor-local dependency materialization and a current Luna/Codex Forge runtime lineage implementation; both exceed launcher-only repair and would require implementation/packaging work, not a restart.

statement: An existing local CStar worktree may already provide a compliant successor-local dependency/runtime seam that avoids installation or source changes.

observations: No compliant existing seam was found. All local CStar runtime manifests remain Hermes/MiniMax, all inspected source branches retain the same real non-symlink successor-local node_modules requirement, and no existing external dependency-root override is implemented.
